parsed.summary: The change sets a default for SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY, which could introduce a behavioral regression risk for applications that rely on the Referer header.

issues.description: Changing the default to 'same-origin' may break existing applications that depend on the Referer header for verification or analytics.
